meaning:
1) to mourn, be dark
1a) (Qal) to be dark
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to darken
1b2) to cause to mourn
1c) (Hithpael) to grow dark

elsewhere.note: In a little while, the sky grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.
I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
For this the earth will mourn, and the heavens above be black, because I have spoken it. I have planned it, and I have not repented, neither will I turn back…
“The Lord Yahweh says: ‘In the day when he went down to Sheol I caused a mourning. I covered the deep for him, and I restrained its rivers. The great waters…
The earth quakes before them. The heavens tremble. The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
“Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be…
